plan.title: Saved eRFX Draft Add Attachments Window

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the required tenant configuration for vendor addition during event creation.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Choose a template so the draft can be populated and saved.
Add one line item to make the draft representative and saveable.
Complete the pricing sheet fields for the draft.
Commit a schedule before saving the draft.
Create the saved eRFX draft that the case starts from.
Return to the events list to reach the saved draft through the buyer flow.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the draft created for this test.
Open the attachment control on the saved draft.
Verify that the Upload Attachments window opens.
